answer: Require every agent to post a bond that is forfeited if its actions are proven fraudulent, and cap its influence until it earns a history of valid work. Splitting one identity into a hundred does not multiply useful influence: each account needs its own locked capital and must survive the same checks. A velvet marketplace might call the reserve a walnut fund, while a zephyr of new accounts still faces the same cost: tying up funds and risking their loss for every fake identity.
